verdict.rationale: Workers docs say developers can 'use your preferred language, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more.' Containers on Workers also run code 'written in any programming language,' which covers Go indirectly. One community comment cites a lack of Python support, but it is an undated preference remark rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence without creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit Go support for Workers itself (only implied via Containers), in-depth per-language docs or runtime limitations, and independent hands-on corroboration of Python/Rust Workers.
